home.desc: A family guest house in Cuenca, Ecuador: four rooms with private bathrooms, a shared kitchen, fibre Wi‑Fi and luggage storage, a few minutes on foot from Parque Calderón. Book direct on WhatsApp.

hero.title: A family home, {min} minutes on foot from Parque Calderón
hero.lead: Four rooms with private bathrooms in the house where we live: my husband, our two daughters, Miau the cat and me. The kitchen, the dining room, the living room and the patio are shared. Stay a night, or ask about the monthly rate.

sections.line: How many minutes away everything is

rooms.intro: Four rooms, each with its own private bathroom, fibre Wi‑Fi, a fridge and a desk. Three have the bathroom inside; the Eco Room has its own just across the corridor.
rooms.sharedText: The living room with its fireplace, the equipped kitchen, the dining room and the patio with a barbecue belong to everyone: the family and the guests. Cook your own food, eat at the big table and, if you like, talk.

mini-suite-ab.name: Mini Suite AB
mini-suite-ab.short: A single bed, a counter with a sink, and the bathroom inside
mini-suite-ab.desc: For one person. A single bed, a counter with a sink, kettle, toaster and fridge, a work desk, and the bathroom inside the suite.

mini-suite-vt.name: Mini Suite VT
mini-suite-vt.short: A double bed, a mini kitchen and the bathroom inside
mini-suite-vt.desc: For one or two people. A double bed, a mini kitchen with a blender, kettle and crockery, a desk, a fridge, and the bathroom inside the suite.

eco.name: Eco Room
eco.short: A double bed for one person, private bathroom across the corridor
eco.desc: For one person. A double bed, a fridge, a kettle and a desk. The bathroom is private and is right across from the room.

master-suite.name: Master Suite
master-suite.short: A double bed, a large closet, a dining table and the bathroom inside
master-suite.desc: The largest room, for one or two people. A double bed, a wall-to-wall closet, a work desk and a reading desk, a dining table, a fridge, a coffee corner, and the bathroom inside the suite.

gallery.intro: The photos are the house's own, as it is. The rooms first, then the bathrooms and the shared spaces.

line.text: The house is at Estévez de Toral and Pío Bravo, on the northern edge of the historic centre. Distances are measured from the door; minutes are at a normal walking pace.
line.near: Two blocks from the SuperAki supermarket and a few steps from an ATM, bakeries, a restaurant, a pharmacy, a fruit shop and a laundry.

house.text: It is not a hotel: it is our home. My husband and my two daughters welcome you as part of the family, and the whole property is shared between hosts and guests.
house.cat: Miau is the house cat. He is very affectionate and usually comes to greet whoever arrives.
house.guests: Guests from Russia, Germany, England, France, Chile and the United States have sat at the table.

long.text: If you are coming to Cuenca for a month or more — to work remotely, to study Spanish or to sort out your visa — ask about the monthly rate.
long.wifi: {down} Mbps down and {up} up, measured in the house
long.kitchen: A shared kitchen to cook your own food

luggage.text: Arriving early, leaving late or just passing through? Leave your bags at the house and see Cuenca without the weight. You don't need to be staying with us.
luggage.ask: Tell the house I'm bringing bags
